activity.detail: Created the tracker site and GitHub Pages / Vercel-ready setup.
Scanned Remote Rocketship, Himalayas, Cutshort, Built In, Weekday, Remotive, Jobicy, WeWorkRemotely and Greenhouse boards; collected ~45 remote-India and Hyderabad openings.
Matched against data-analyst/v3 resume (SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, stats, 2+ yrs).
Opened ~25 postings to check they are open, remote from India, and the experience ask; dropped on-site, 5+ yr, and off-profile roles.
Ranked by fit and interview odds; status set to 'Ready to apply'. Backups and skipped roles kept with reasons.

Checked each top-10 job at the employer's own site. Handshake (US-hours senior role) and Ruder Finn (no live posting) dropped; Verizon and Gainsight (Hyderabad) added; Kard moved to its live Wellfound posting, Peakflo to YC Work at a Startup.
One short cover note per top-10 job, shown on each card with a Copy button.

Checked all 10 forms. DoorDash and Peakflo closed. Kard, Photon, Pontoon and Verizon need your account sign-in; Integrate needs your Aadhaar details. Weekday, Gainsight and LG Ad Solutions ready to submit once you confirm salary and notice.
